research_note: Curated from primary pages, abstracts and project descriptions. Books, recordings and code were not fully read, watched or executed. No verified future conference match is included in this pass.

resources.title: Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control
resources.why: Introduces the coordinate frames, motion and feedback control needed to connect perception to movement.
resources.caveat: The authors provide a free preprint; examples are not specific to the workshop SDK.

resources.title: Motion Control with Velocity Inputs, Part 2
resources.why: Gives a focused introduction to tracking a target with feedforward and PI feedback.
resources.caveat: University description and transcript checked; video playback was not tested.

resources.title: OpenCV tutorials
resources.why: Provides camera calibration and image-processing background for interpreting vehicle camera data.
resources.caveat: Independent background material; the workshop page does not say that its SDK uses OpenCV.
